beats.summary: Michael interviews with David for Jan's job and discusses his strengths and weaknesses.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Why don't I tell you what my greatest weaknesses are? I work too hard. I care too much. And sometimes I can be too invested in my job.
David: Okay, uh. Well, I thought it was clear in the description, the position… the job you're applying for… is Jan's job.

beats.summary: Jan confronts David about her job performance and is told she is unstable and being let go.

evidence.snippet: David: The time has come for you to end your professional relationship with this company. You are clearly unstable.

beats.summary: Michael and Jan share a kiss and discuss running away together to Jamaica.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Daaah, let's just run away together. Let's just run away to Jamaica and live in a bungalow.

beats.summary: Dwight introduces the Schrute Buck system to motivate employees and starts a lecture on paper knowledge.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Instead, today I will begin my first lecture in a long series of lectures designed to increase your knowledge on the world of paper.

beats.summary: Andy cancels Dwight's paper lecture, causing tension among employees.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: No wait, what are you doing?!

beats.summary: Karen shares her five-year plan and expresses that Michael would be a disaster in Jan's job.

evidence.snippet: Karen: He's a very nice man. And he's very well suited for the job he has now.
Michael: Well, my weaknesses are actually… strengths.
